description: Carpoolear is an open-source software tool listed in Awesome Sustainable Technology, a curated list of open-source sustainability projects under the section "Mobility and Transportation", published or maintained by STS-Rosario (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). is the first Argentine Facebook app that allow the users of this social network share car trips with other users. Coverage: not geographically bound. The list files it under "Mobility and Transportation" (mobility and transport). The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (repository not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and transport studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-sustainable-technology.
